_doc: Which claudiverse features this build still gets from a binary patch. state: patch = the hook is spliced in; replaced = a non-patch mechanism provides it and the hook is left out; off = neither. build.sh applies the hooks of every feature in state patch. Flip ONE feature at a time and test before the next. A replaced feature with a `provides` name is handed to the API proxy by launch.sh (X-Claudiverse-Provides).

001-session.replacement: proxy (x-claude-code-session-id on every request) or SessionStart hook
001-session.note: Also publishes upstream's OAuth refresh registrar, which 012's 401-renewal leg needs.

002-mirroring.replacement: proxy in primary mode (X-Claudiverse-Provides: mirror) writes the conversation into the seat's own row; overlay/proxy-mirror-no-sidecar-prompt-echo.patch stops the sidecar echoing typed prompts

003-inject.replacement: server-hosted MCP channel (/api/mcp/seat/<title>, server fedc7f7): cv_send to an idle seat is a channel message; also relays permission prompts
003-inject.note: Channel route built (server fedc7f7) but channels are gated by a Claude Code feature flag that is off on a pooled (cv-pool) seat; on a seat with its own login it was on. Keep the patch while seats are pooled.

005-commands.replacement: none needed: nothing registers commands since 004 was retired

006-canary.replacement: none: kept so a semi seat always identifies itself
006-canary.note: Never flip this one while the variant exists.

007-remote-answer.replacement: HTTP PreToolUse hook on AskUserQuestion (/api/hooks/seat/<title>/pretooluse, server fedc7f7), held until cv_answer

008-010-idle.replacement: proxy in primary mode (provides idle): main-thread request lifecycle + startup idle (server 160b95e); overlay/proxy-idle-no-sidecar-cvstate-fallback.patch keeps the sidecar's fallback heartbeat from overriding it

009-compact.replacement: proxy in primary mode (provides compact): the compaction request class, labelled by Claude Code itself

011-trust.replacement: launch.sh gives each seat its own CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and pre-writes the work dir's hasTrustDialogAccepted there

012-failover.replacement: proxy credential swap from the pool (server 11b85b5): pooled seat sends Bearer cv-pool; overlay/pooled-seat-no-local-credentials.patch keeps the sidecar from handing it a real token
